"""Legacy-compatible EXPORT_ACCT fixed-width record formatter."""

from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP, localcontext
from typing import Any

__all__ = ["format_account"]


def _is_empty(value: Any) -> bool:
    return value is None or value == ""


def _fixed(value: Any, width: int) -> str:
    text = "" if _is_empty(value) else str(value)
    return text[:width].ljust(width)


def _zpad_cents(value: Any, width: int) -> str:
    if _is_empty(value):
        value = 0

    decimal_value = value if isinstance(value, Decimal) else Decimal(str(value))
    precision = max(
        50,
        len(decimal_value.as_tuple().digits)
        + abs(decimal_value.as_tuple().exponent)
        + width
        + 2,
    )

    with localcontext() as context:
        context.prec = precision
        cents = (decimal_value * Decimal(100)).to_integral_value(
            rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP
        )

    return str(int(cents)).zfill(width)


def format_account(row: dict) -> str:
    """Build one 77-character legacy EXPORT_ACCT record."""
    cred_hold = row.get("CRED_HOLD", "")
    if _is_empty(cred_hold):
        cred_hold = "N"

    create_dt = row.get("CREATE_DT", "")
    if _is_empty(create_dt):
        create_dt = "00000000"

    return (
        _fixed(row.get("ACCT_ID", ""), 10)
        + _fixed(row.get("ACCT_NM", ""), 40)
        + _fixed(row.get("REGION_CD", ""), 3)
        + _zpad_cents(row.get("ANN_REV", ""), 15)
        + str(cred_hold)
        + str(create_dt)
    )
